methodology_note: Figures are pulled from one fixed source (Redfin's Lake Nona neighborhood page) each quarter, not averaged across providers. Other public sources (Realtor.com, Orchard, RPR-based agent reports) show different numbers for the same period because they use different geographic boundaries (all of Lake Nona vs. a single zip code vs. one sub-neighborhood), different time windows (30-day vs. trailing 3-month vs. trailing 12-month), and different underlying data (public estimate vs. MLS-sourced). This is disclosed on the page, not smoothed over.
disclaimer: Market context only. Not an appraisal, and not a guarantee of price, timeline, or outcome for any specific home.
